definitions.explanation: Deep faith in the character, ability, or integrity of someone or something.

examples.japanese: {上司|じょうし}からの{信頼|しんらい}が{厚|あつ}い。
examples.english: He is highly trusted by his boss.
examples.notes: 信頼が厚い means 'to be deeply trusted'

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}できる{人|ひと}に{相談|そうだん}した。
examples.english: I consulted with someone I trust.

examples.japanese: {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい}を{築|きず}くには{時間|じかん}がかかる。
examples.english: It takes time to build a relationship of trust.

notes:
{信頼|しんらい} implies a deeper level of trust than {信用|しんよう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {信頼|しんらい}する (to trust, to rely on)
- {信頼|しんらい}できる (trustworthy, reliable)
- {信頼|しんらい}{関係|かんけい} (relationship of trust)
- {信頼|しんらい}を{裏切|うらぎ}る (to betray trust)
- {信頼|しんらい}が{厚|あつ}い (to be deeply trusted)
- {信頼|しんらい}を{置|お}く (to place trust in)

COMPARISON:
- {信頼|しんらい}: trust (in character, deeper relationship)
- {信用|しんよう}: trust (more practical, credit-related)
